faqs.question: 1. UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture Main Examination Online Form Start Date?
faqs.answer: The online application process starts on 17 September 2026 and ends on 07 October 2026.

faqs.question: 2. UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture Main Exam Date?
faqs.answer: The examination will be conducted as per official UPSSSC schedule.

faqs.question: 3. What is the eligibility for UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have UPSSSC PET 2025 score card, 10th High School pass, and a 3-Year Diploma in Agricultural Engineering from a recognized institute.

faqs.question: 4. What is the total number of vacancies in UPSSSC JE Agriculture 2026?
faqs.answer: Total 134 vacancies (UR: 54, EWS: 13, OBC: 43, SC: 23, ST: 1).

faqs.question: 5. What is the application fee for UPSSSC JE Agriculture 2026?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹25/- for all categories (General / OBC / EWS / SC / ST / PH).

faqs.question: 6. UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture Recruitment Last Date?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply online and pay exam fee is 07 October 2026 (Form Correction till 14 October 2026).

faqs.question: 7. How can I apply for UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture Main Exam 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website https://upsssc.gov.in/ using their PET 2025 registration credentials.
